data.command: $tag='aiw-say-fd036-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'); $testExe=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'.exe'); $env:GOCACHE=Join-Path $env:TEMP ($tag+'-cache'); $env:GOPROXY='off'; $env:GOSUMDB='off'; $env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'; go build -o $testExe ./cmd/aiw-say; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'go build failed' }; $env:AIW_SAY_BIN=$testExe; python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox
data.scope: Compile cmd/aiw-say to a random TEMP executable, then run only tests.test_fd036_say_blackbox against the local loopback mock server.
data.side_effects: Unique random TEMP executable and isolated Go build cache remain after execution. Python test temporary directory auto-cleans. Environment variables are confined to the PowerShell child process. GOPROXY and GOSUMDB disable downloads/checksum network; Python bytecode disabled. No repository or user configuration writes, external API calls, or privilege changes.
data.risk_review: Inspected the standard-library mock server, temporary config, subprocess timeout and assertions. Command is offline, focused, and limited to one module plus uniquely named temporary files.
